question: On the six previously weak-compatible checkpoints, can a single aligned formatting change distinguish the registered Mistral reference from every one of the five opposite-conflict small references?
fixtures: Fixed public SHA-derived strings, separate three development and three confirmation dockets, exact match and different REQ-prefixed code, identity and swapped maps, two greedy completions per text. Only the advisory heading OR position changes. No conflicting claims in any weak prompt.
control: Baseline is the original aligned format. All six must produce the written-rule symbol on all 12 repeated baseline cells. All candidate symbols must be stable and Mistral must match the rule on all cells. Each small reference must differ from Mistral on at least two distinct dockets, spanning both answer maps. Separating all 15 pairs of individuals is not required; report all signature groups, even on a no-go.
decision: Choose the first qualifying candidate on development, otherwise stop without acquiring confirmation or calling an endpoint. On confirmation run baseline and only the locked candidate. Apply the identical gate. No replacement or post-outcome tuning. Missing/unparseable/unstable answers cannot establish a difference.
positive_path: Only if confirmation passes, collect the six references on the unmodified conflict variant of the confirmation dockets, retain every compatible complete weak signature and lock a conditional lookup BEFORE any fresh endpoint answers. Primary forecast requires at least two named family groups; a single-family branch is descriptive only. Unseen/incomplete endpoint signatures and unresolved reference conflicts abstain. The lookup is not an issued endpoint prediction. A future target-specific lock requires a new endpoint weak observation before any conflict answers.
limits: Development 432 reference generations. Conditional confirmation 288 and conditional conflict 144. Zero new API calls under this reference-only acquisition; no model training, downloads, runtime retuning or retries for a nicer answer.
interpretation: Reference-only format diagnostic on a retrospective six-checkpoint cohort, not target prediction, registry-wide novelty detection, scale effect or an internal-mechanism discovery. Dockets, not their repeats or codebook permutations, are case units.
